proposed_comments.title: Limit menu-character suppression to shelf digits

confidence.rationale: The current unconditional WM_MENUCHAR branch returns MNC_CLOSE for every unmatched mnemonic, while the shelf only needs Alt+0 through Alt+9 chime suppression.

proposed_comments.title: Refresh access keys when repeater elements are reused

confidence.rationale: Visible shelf items and their indexes are rebuilt as capacity changes, while OneTime bindings do not reliably refresh values on recycled ItemsRepeater elements.

proposed_comments.body:
### Refresh access keys when repeater elements are reused

**Severity:** `medium`

The visible shelf collection is rebuilt when available capacity changes, and `ItemsRepeater` can reuse an existing element for a different `QuickAccessShelfItem`. With `Mode=OneTime`, the button and tooltip can retain the previous item's digit, exposing a stale shortcut and invoking a different command than the UI advertises. Keep these three bindings live so recycled elements receive the current item's shortcut.

```suggestion
                                AccessKey="{x:Bind ShortcutDigit, Mode=OneWay}"
                                AutomationProperties.Name="{x:Bind Command.Title, Mode=OneWay}"
                                Click="QuickAccessShelfItem_Click"
                                Style="{StaticResource SubtleButtonStyle}"
                                Tag="{x:Bind}"
                                UseSystemFocusVisuals="{StaticResource UseSystemFocusVisuals}">
                                <ToolTipService.ToolTip>
                                    <ToolTip>
                                        <StackPanel Spacing="2">
                                            <TextBlock Text="{x:Bind Command.Title, Mode=OneWay}" />
                                            <TextBlock
                                                Foreground="{ThemeResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                Style="{StaticResource CaptionTextBlockStyle}"
                                                Text="{x:Bind ShortcutDigit, Mode=OneWay, Converter={StaticResource QuickAccessShortcutTextConverter}}"
                                                Visibility="{x:Bind ShortcutDigit, Mode=OneWay, Converter={StaticResource StringNotEmptyToVisibilityConverter}}" />
```

proposed_comments.title: Provide the custom landmark type for assistive technology

confidence.rationale: The shelf declares LandmarkType=Custom, and WinUI requires AutomationProperties.LocalizedLandmarkType to describe a custom landmark.

proposed_comments.body:
### Provide the custom landmark type for assistive technology

**Severity:** `medium`

The shelf is declared as a custom landmark, but its `x:Uid` supplies only an accessible name. Custom landmarks also require a localized landmark type; without it, screen readers cannot announce what kind of region users entered. Add the matching localized resource for this surface.

```suggestion
  <data name="QuickAccessShelfSurface.[using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation]AutomationProperties.Name" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Quick access</value>
  </data>
  <data name="QuickAccessShelfSurface.[using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation]AutomationProperties.LocalizedLandmarkType" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Quick access shelf</value>
  </data>
```

proposed_comments.title: Hide decorative overflow icons from the UI Automation tree

confidence.rationale: Each MenuFlyoutItem already exposes its command title, while the generated IconBox has no independent accessible name and otherwise remains visible to UI Automation.

proposed_comments.body:
### Hide decorative overflow icons from the UI Automation tree

**Severity:** `medium`

Each overflow menu item already exposes its command title, so the generated icon is decorative. Leaving the `IconBox` in the content accessibility view can create a separate unlabeled UI Automation node beside every command. Mark it as raw to keep the menu's accessible structure focused on the named item.

```suggestion
            iconBox.SourceRequested += IconProvider.SourceRequested16;
            Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.AutomationProperties.SetAccessibilityView(
                iconBox,
                Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Automation.Peers.AccessibilityView.Raw);
```

proposed_comments.title: Let the focused filter keep its Alt+Down shortcut

confidence.rationale: The shell preview handler runs before the filter control's handler and currently consumes Alt+Down whenever collapsed compact mode can expand.
